听.title: Who does the housework?（谁来做家务？）
听.body:
Introduction
Unloading the dishwasher, mopping the floor, cleaning the loo... what is your most hated household chore? We all know there are jobs around the house which have to be done regularly, even if they are sometimes boring or unpleasant. But who tends to do the most amount of jobs in your household?

Neil: Hello, this is 6 Minute English from BBC Learning English. I'm Neil.
Pippa: And I'm Pippa. When it comes to household chores, jobs like cleaning, washing clothes or looking after the kids, it's often women who do most of the work.

Vocabulary: chores (日常家务); fair share (合理的那一份); women's work (对女性刻板家务的贬称); division of labour (劳动分工); take a breather (歇口气); pull your weight (尽本分).
听.zh:
【本期导语】洗碗、拖地、刷马桶……你最讨厌的家务是什么？家里这些活总得有人定期干，可到底谁干得最多？
【重点摘录】主持人 Neil 与 Pippa 聊到：家务（chores）常由女性承担更多；联合国妇女署数据显示，全球女性每天比男性多花约3小时在无酬照护与家务上。节目介绍印尼 Rote 岛与克罗地亚'Superdads'等项目，倡导夫妻共同分担。
【每周一问】据 Good Housekeeping 调查，英国人最讨厌的家务是擦窗户（cleaning the windows），占比23%。
【词汇】chores 日常家务；fair share 合理的份额；women's work 对女性刻板家务的贬义说法；division of labour 劳动分工；take a breather 歇口气；pull your weight 尽到自己那份力。

读.title: Robots rapidly adapt to real-world tasks（机器人加速适应真实世界任务）
读.body:
The second World Humanoid Robot Games, which concluded in Beijing on Wednesday, demonstrated the rapid advances being made in the field of embodied artificial intelligence, with humanoid robots breaking records and completing increasingly complex real-world tasks.

Rather than just being a showcase for cutting-edge technology, the five-day event put robots to the test in demanding physical and practical scenarios, helping turn technological breakthroughs into solutions for everyday applications, experts said.

One of the highlights was the tug-of-war competition between humanoid robots. Debuting as an official event, it tested the robots' balance, coordination and grip. The entire competition was completed autonomously through AI algorithms.
读.zh: 【节选】第二届世界人形机器人运动会本周三在北京落幕，展现出具身智能领域的快速进步——人形机器人在打破纪录的同时，完成了越来越复杂的真实世界任务。这场为期五天的赛事不只是前沿技术的秀场，更把机器人置于高难度的体力与实用场景中检验，推动技术突破转化为日常应用方案。其中一大亮点是人机拔河对抗赛，作为正式项目首次亮相，考验机器人的平衡、协调与抓握能力，全程由AI算法自主完成。

说.title: 口语练习·家务分工
说.body: Describe how housework is shared in your home. Use at least three of these words: chores, fair share, division of labour, pull your weight, take a breather. (Say 3-5 sentences.)
说.zh: 【练习】用英语描述你家里家务是怎么分工的，至少用到以下三个词：chores、fair share、division of labour、pull your weight、take a breather。说3-5句话即可。

练.title: 随堂小测·词汇填空
练.body:
Fill in the blanks:
1. My roommate never does the dishes - he never ______ his ______.
2. After a long shift, I just want to ______ a ______.
3. In our family we have a clear ______ of ______.
练.zh:
【练习】选词填空：
1. 我室友从不做饭洗碗——他从不______（尽本分）。
2. 上完长班，我只想______（歇口气）。
3. 我们家有明确的______（劳动分工）。
答案：1. pulls his weight  2. take a breather  3. division of labour
